structuur datasets:

verdeling van de diagnoses:
```{r}
table(metadata$diagnosis)

ggplot(metadata, aes(x = diagnosis, fill = diagnosis)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of psychiatric diagnoses",
    x = "Diagnosis",
    y = "Number of samples"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

diagnoses per brain region:
```{r}
table(metadata$brain_region, metadata$diagnosis)

ggplot(metadata, aes(x = brain_region, fill = diagnosis)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Diagnosis distribution across brain regions",
    x = "Brain region",
    y = "Number of samples",
    fill = "Diagnosis"
  )
```

sample_ids matchen:
```{r}
sample_ids <- colnames(count_data)[-1]

all(sample_ids %in% metadata$description)
all(metadata$description %in% sample_ids)
```
omzetten count matrix (5.4.)
```{r}
gene_counts <- count_data %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") %>%
  as.matrix()

storage.mode(gene_counts) <- "numeric"

# Metadata in dezelfde volgorde zetten als counts
metadata <- metadata[
  match(colnames(gene_counts), metadata$description),
]

rownames(metadata) <- metadata$description

stopifnot(
  identical(colnames(gene_counts), rownames(metadata))
)
```



genen met heel lage sequentie uitfilteren:
```{r}
keep_genes <- rowSums(gene_counts > 0) > 0

filtered_counts <- gene_counts[keep_genes, ]

dim(filtered_counts)
```

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

BiocManager::install("DESeq2")
```
```{r}
library(DESeq2)
```

normalisation for differential expression
```{r}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = filtered_counts,
  colData = metadata,
  design = ~ diagnosis
)

dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)

normalized_counts <- counts(
  dds,
  normalized = TRUE
)
```
```{r}
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE)

expression_matrix <- assay(vsd)

dim(expression_matrix)
```



exploration of gene expression (PCA (Principal Component Analysis))
```{r}
pca_data <- plotPCA(
  vsd,
  intgroup = c("diagnosis", "brain_region"),
  returnData = TRUE
)

percentVar <- round(
  100 * attr(pca_data, "percentVar")
)

ggplot(pca_data, aes(
  x = PC1,
  y = PC2,
  color = diagnosis,
  shape = brain_region
)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of gene expression",
    x = paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"),
    y = paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")
  )
```

bekijk sample variatie:
```{r}
boxplot(
  log2(normalized_counts + 1),
  outline = FALSE,
  las = 2,
  main = "Normalized gene expression",
  ylab = "log2(normalized counts + 1)"
)
```

```{r}
# Maximum count per gene over alle samples
gene_max <- apply(gene_counts, 1, max)

# Bekijk de grootste waarden
sort(gene_max, decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]

class(gene_max)
```

```{r}
# Summary statistics
summary(gene_max)

# Quantiles
quantile(
  gene_max,
  probs = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.90, 0.95, 0.99, 0.999)
)
```

```{r}
newcounts <- count_data [1:281, 1:281] %>%
  pivot_longer(names_to="sample", values_to="counts",-"gene_id")

ggplot(data=newcounts, aes(x=sample, y=counts)) + geom_boxplot()
```
